coverage_issues: Qwen model failed to audit .SRCINFO due to an LLM API HTTP 400 error, resulting in an overall inconclusive verdict.
learnings: Transient API errors on non-executable metadata files (like .SRCINFO) should not force an overall 'inconclusive' verdict if the security-critical files (PKGBUILD, .install) are successfully audited and deemed safe.
